Independent relevance review

No model rankings are used in this worksheet. Unjudged is different from irrelevant.

Grades:0 irrelevant or a clear mandatory-attribute conflict;1 weak/partial match;2 useful relevant result;3 clear match for all requested visible attributes. Leave uncertain facts unjudged and record why. Source attributes may help identify products but do not prove hidden material or properties.

This candidate pool is a seeded independent subset. It is not a complete relevance set, and unjudged products must not be called human negatives. Recall remains unavailable without complete judgements. Keep your own saved CSV; browser form state is not a research record until exported.
